title: Burst credit rebalancer double-allocation causing small-tenant capacity starvation
creator: Lena Park
description: Production customer escalations reported repeated coldstarts and 429 throttles for multiple small tenants during a weekend traffic surge. Investigation traced the symptom to the burst-credit rebalancer allocating the same burst credits twice across leader handoffs, temporarily double-counting available burst budget which allowed some large tenants to consume headroom that should have been reserved — leaving small tenants starved and unable to burst when they needed it.
impact_summary: Between 2025-11-08 02:00 and 2025-11-08 07:00 UTC, 7 customers (3 flagged high-value) saw 5-12x latency spikes and a 30-80% drop in successful requests to dedicated pools. The incident caused two paid customers to file urgent escalations and one to request a credit for SLA violations.
timeline: 2025-11-08 02:15: on-call notified by PagerDuty; 02:30 began triage (telemetry showed burst budget depletion mismatch). 03:10 identified correlated leader election logs for the rebalancer. 04:00 rolled a config throttling rebalancer to mitigate further double allocations. 06:00 mitigations in prod reduced impact; 11-12 follow-up reproduced race locally in stress harness.
root_cause: Race in the burst-credit rebalancer during leader election: two controller replicas temporarily believed they were primary and both applied quota reassignments for the same reserved pool. The coordinator marks were eventually reconciled, but in the interim credits were applied to tenant usages and not immediately reflected in the global ledger, enabling transient overconsumption by larger tenants and starving smaller ones.
immediate_fix_deployed: Hotfix PR #11125: added leader-lease guard and idempotency token to credit application path; added an escrow record so credits are reserved transactionally and reconciled on lease transfer. Deployed as canary to us-west-2 on 2025-11-08 04:05 and rolled globally by 2025-11-08 09:20.
mitigations_until_root_fix: 1) Short-term: limit max per-tenant burst allocation to 2x baseline (config toggle) until ledger reconciliation latency reduced. 2) Temporarily reserve a 10% headroom pool for high-SLA tenants so rebalancer anomalies cannot fully starve small tenants. 3) Alert added on burst-credit ledger divergence > 5%.
verification_plan: - Run 72h stress harness with simulated leader churn and mixed tenant sizes; assert no double allocations. - Canary run against 10% of traffic for 48 hours. - Validate via dashboards: per-tenant burst-usage vs ledger delta should be < 1% across windows.
acceptance_criteria: 1) No observed double allocation in stress harness for 3 leader switches. 2) Canary shows <2% increase in coldstarts compared to baseline. 3) Production ledger divergence alert not triggered for 7 days.
customer_notes: Support ticket #C-229102: AcmeRetail reported repeated 429s and requested timeline. Root cause and mitigation explained; credit offered for 5% of November invoice.
Support ticket #C-229118: Small fintech tenant requested immediate isolation; recommended Dedicated slot reservation until fix. Action: Solutions Eng to scope temporary reserved capacity.
Escalation email to Enterprise Success sent 2025-11-09 15:20 UTC with RCA draft.
